Rules & lab checklist

Six pieces per player. Blue moves first. Men move and capture diagonally forward. Captures are compulsory; complete every available jump in a chain. Kings move one diagonal square or jump in either direction. Promotion ends your turn. No legal moves means a loss. Eighty turns without a capture or promotion means a draw.

For a web move, move the physical pieces to match the screen, including captured pieces. Green lights show where to place; orange shows where to remove. The next turn stays paused until they match. Magnet presence does not identify a piece’s colour or king status.

This session runs in this browser. Refreshing clears it. USB play needs this laptop attached. Wi-Fi play uses a paired board and the connection service. Remote-browser multiplayer is not implemented; this browser still owns the game.
